newsitem.title: UK: NYNEX Cable shareholders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX Cable shareholders approve merger.

text.p: NYNEX CableComms Group Plc said on Thursday its shareholders had approved its merger with the Cable & Wireless Communications (CWC)group which will become Britain's biggest cable company.
The new group brings together Mercury Communications Ltd, the UK subsidiary of Cable & Wireless and three cable television units of NYNEX Corp and Bell Cablemedia Plc.
Shareholders in Cable and Wireless Plc had overwhelmingly backed the creation of the new group last Thursday at an extraordinary general meeting.
Cable & Wireless Communications, which has been valued by analysts at between 4.5-7.0 billion pounds, will serve about 1.2 million telephony customers and 580,000 cable television customers.
